@@U02763@@
About your heads hover the forms of all living things, in motion, and yet dead. What once was, in all radiance and splendor, moves there still, seeking a place in Eternity. And you, in your omnipotence, divide it between the bright canopy of day and the vault of night; some to be caught up in life’s bless¢d course, others to be sought out by the fearless magician, who alone, intrepidly, reveals for all to see, what is worthy of wonder.

@@U02765@@
His glowing key no sooner touches the censer than at once a misty vapor engulfs the stage. Stealing in, it billows in cloudlike fashion, stretching, swelling, condensing, twining about, parting, joining. But now behold a spirit masterpiece. As they approach they make music! Airy tones create a mystery, and as they move all things become melody. Everything, columns, triglyph, rings; I truly believe the entire temple is singing! The mist is settling now, and through the haze, with measured step, a beautiful youth steps forth. Here I end my task, for I needn't name him. Who could fail to know the charming Paris.

@@U02766@@
(PARIS steps forward.)

@@U02768@@
O what a sight of youth and vigor!
translation:
@@U02763@@
在你们的头顶上盘旋着所有生物的形状，它们在运动，但又是死的。曾经的一切，在所有的光辉和辉煌中，仍然移动在那里，在永恒中寻找一席之地。而你，以你的全能，将它分为明亮的白天和黑夜的穹顶；有些人会被幸福的人生所吸引，另一些人则被无畏的魔术师所寻找，他们独自无畏地向所有人揭示了什么是值得惊叹的。

@@U02765@@
他发光的钥匙一接触香炉，舞台上立刻就笼罩着一层薄雾。它偷偷地进来，像云一样翻腾，伸展、膨胀、凝结、缠绕、分离、结合。但现在看到的是精神杰作。当他们靠近时，他们会演奏音乐！轻快的音调创造出一种神秘感，当它们移动时，一切都变成了旋律。一切，柱子，三字形，环；我真的相信整个寺庙都在唱歌！雾气渐渐散去，透过薄雾，一个美丽的少年迈着稳健的步伐走了出来。我的任务到此结束，因为我不必说出他的名字。谁能不知道迷人的巴黎。

@@U02766@@
（巴黎向前迈出了一步。）

@@U02768@@
啊，这是多么青春和活力的景象啊！
